caption: The drawing depicts a composition of folded and draped textiles and accessories arranged horizontally in the center of a plain, beige background. The primary colors used are various shades of pink, ranging from light pastel to deep magenta. On the left side, a light pink, soft, and crumpled fabric appears to be gathered or folded. Next to it, pieces of pink and lavender cloth are arranged in layers, some decorated with rows of small, green dots or diamonds, and embellished with gold and purple patterns including small circular ornaments. To the right, there is a more vivid pink fabric with a ruffled edge and layered elements in both pink and white. The composition is centralized with significant empty space surrounding the objects, and all elements share a fabric-like texture with decorative detailing.
title: Hat
